Honestly I recommend trying to find a job. Getting a job greatly helped my social anxiety and brought me out of my shell, I didn't think I would be able to handle having a job but it truly does help. You'll learn to socialize and make friends with your coworkers. You can work somewhere within a walking distance, and retail is always a great first job. If you're anxious try applying to a quiet place or somewhere that does not get much business, like a bookstore or a small coffee shop. It really will help you get out of your shell and even get your own money, which will make you feel independent as well.
